meta.name: muapi-youtube-shorts
meta.description: Auto-generate viral 9:16 YouTube Shorts (or TikTok / Reels clips) from a long-form video. Thin platform-aware wrapper around the AI Clipping skill — picks sensible defaults for short-form social platforms (9:16, 30–60s sweet spot) and delegates the actual highlight extraction + crop to muapi.ai's `/ai-clipping` endpoint.

copy.tagline: 从长视频自动生成竖版短视频爆款
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速从长视频中提取精彩片段做成短视频。
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate viral vertical shorts from long videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly extract highlights from long videos into short clips.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的长视频链接，自动生成多个 9:16 竖屏短视频片段，适合发到 YouTube Shorts、TikTok 或 Reels。它会提取高光时刻、自动裁剪并给出评分和推荐理由。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一个长视频链接（如 YouTube 链接），并明确要求生成短视频片段时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这段 YouTube 视频里生成 3 个 Shorts 片段。
say.note: 使用默认平台（YouTube Shorts）和默认参数。

say.text: 用 TikTok 预设，从这段视频生成 5 个竖屏片段。
say.note: 指定平台为 TikTok，生成 5 个片段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take a long-form video URL and automatically generate multiple 9:16 vertical short clips suitable for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, or Reels. It extracts highlights, auto-crops, and provides scores and reasons.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a long video URL (e.g., YouTube link) and ask to generate short clips.

say_en.text: Generate 3 Shorts clips from this YouTube video.
say_en.note: Uses default platform (YouTube Shorts) and defaults.

say_en.text: Use TikTok preset, generate 5 vertical clips from this video.
